metadata.description: Mods for running many Claude Code sessions across repos from one place.

plugins.name: beacon
plugins.description: Desktop notifications when a session needs you (permission prompt, question, long turn done), plus a status file per session.

plugins.name: tower
plugins.description: A control-tower pane: every running session across your repos, who needs you, and buttons to send prompts, answer, jump to or launch sessions.

plugins.name: strip
plugins.description: A status line with folder, git branch, model, effort, permission mode, context fill and session cost.
